distractors.reason: We say 'opt out of', not 'opt out from'. 'Of' is the fixed preposition with 'opt out'.
'To' does not follow 'opt out'. Learn 'opt out of' as one fixed chunk.
'For' does not follow 'opt out'. The fixed preposition is 'of'.

example_sentence: You can ___ location tracking in the app settings.
l1_interference: Türkçe konuşanlar 'opt out' ifadesinin edatını Türkçedeki ek mantığıyla kurup 'opt out from' ya da 'opt out to' gibi yanlış edatlar kullanabilir. İngilizcede bu ifade için sabit edat 'of' kullanılır, bu yüzden 'opt out of' kalıbını bir bütün olarak ezberleyin.
explanation: In English, 'opt out of' means choosing not to take part in something, such as a service or data collection. The preposition 'of' is fixed after this phrasal verb.

related_collocations.example: Users must opt in to receive marketing emails.
Apps can keep track of your location.

memory_tip: OPT OUT OF = choose to leave something (tracking, emails, cookies) | OPT IN TO = choose to join something
